title: Giấc mơ hợp xướng
about: Round x10, for sleep with improvised melodies (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked to go on ("ok chúng ta hãy tiếp tục sáng tác nhạc"), on the sounds the user liked most: a dream of a far choir: the choir and the pad breathing slowly, a single low string improvising over them, a deep sub. F minor. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece; its melody made up by the improviser in dark/ambient.py.
